note: Both sets share significant errors: claiming a 5/16" bolt for Module A (unsupported by text, likely confused with the 3'-1 5/16" dimension) and misattributing the L3X3X1/4 angle profile to Module A (leaders are visually in Module B). Set A is better because it correctly binds the L3X3X1/4 profile to Module B, whereas Set B only offers a generic 'Angle' claim for this value, missing the specific component association. Set A includes some redundancy (listing the through bolt twice) but captures more valid engineering relationships.
